description: Knob 5: five knobs, each putting out a constant voltage on its own jack

params.text: Sets the constant voltage at the output of the same number, covering -10V to 10V until its own menu is told otherwise

outputs.text: Carries the constant voltage of the knob of the same number, monophonic unless that knob's menu sets more channels

menu: Knob range, in a knob's own right-click menu — 0-1 V, 0-2 V, 0-5 V, 0-10 V, +/- 1 V, +/- 2 V, +/- 5 V, +/- 10 V, or Custom, which adds Custom min and Custom max fields
Quantize, in a knob's own right-click menu — Off (Continuous), Integers (Octaves), 1/12V (Semitones), or Custom interval, which adds a Custom quantize interval field
Display unit, in a knob's own right-click menu — reads that knob in volts or in cents
Polyphony channels, in a knob's own right-click menu — how many identical channels that knob's output carries, 1 to 16
Configure all knobs: — a heading on the module's own menu, above copies of Knob range, Quantize, Display unit and Polyphony channels that apply to all five knobs at once
